metadata.title: Understanding Chinese Students’ Well‑Being: A Machine Learning Study

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variables are well-being dimensions measured via questionnaire Likert items, not PV-based cognitive achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not report applying PISA sampling weights or replicate weights in the analyses, indicating that it ran unweighted analyses.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study used random forest regression without mentioning any multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors, indicating that it ignored school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed internal validation using tenfold cross-validation, which does not qualify as validation beyond the estimation sample.
